name: Abogado Javier Marcos
about: Abogado Javier Marcos is a personal injury firm with two offices across Texas.
The firm publishes little about cost or availability on the pages we read. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 2 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours, photo count and description come from the Places API. The services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: Texas does not publish a disciplinary register we can query.

G3.evidence: ABOGADO JAVIER MARCOS, LLC holds an active franchise tax responsibility in Texas with the right to transact business, Secretary of State file 0803655402, chartered 2020-06-08, and 2 Google-verified locations. Identified because the name matches, at an address we verified
G3.source: Active Franchise Taxpayers, published daily as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 6 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 3,340 public client reviews and 6 years since the entity was chartered in 2020
G6.source: Google Places API and Active Franchise Taxpayers, published daily as open data by the Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

score.verdict: 3 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2) and do not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).
